verdict.rationale: Calendly's own scheduling page says users can "fine-tune your availability with meeting buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits," which covers defining working-hour availability schedules. Nothing in the pack documents date-specific overrides or out-of-office periods, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented date overrides, documented out-of-office/vacation blocking, detailed docs on configuring working hours, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can define availability schedules with working hours, date overrides, and out-of-office periods
